title: An Efficacy and Safety Study of ABT-SLV176 for the Treatment of Hypogonadal Men
brief_summary: This is an open-study with a 26 week open label treatment period followed by an optional 26 week open label extension. The total treatment period will be 52 weeks.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Low testosterone

Exclusion Criteria:

* Normal testosterone levels
* Elevated Prostatic Specific Antigen (PSA)
* History of breast or prostate cancer
